title: THE STYLING PASS, STAGE A: ONE LOOK FOR EVERY MENU
why: His order of 2026-10-03: styling across all menus and HUDs needs massive improvement. Stage A lays one look over every HTML menu: glass panes with a soft light from the top, one header style (uppercase amber with a rule under it), rounded buttons of one height with a real gradient primary and a quiet ghost, rows that light on hover, dark rounded inputs with a focus ring, thin scrollbars. Nothing moves and no id or class changes; the raid HUD, the title and the stash get their own stages next.
now: Every menu shares one look now: glass panes, one header style, rounded buttons with a proper primary, cleaner rows, inputs and scrollbars. More stages follow for the title, the raid HUD and the stash.
